title: Basics of Development and Anatomy of Liver

questions.q: Which statement best describes hepatic diverticulum?
questions.exp: The hepatic bud arises from ventral foregut endoderm. (Book p982)

questions.q: Match the key concept in FGF source with its correct interpretation.
questions.exp: FGF is shown from cardiogenic mesoderm. (Book p982)

questions.q: A patient is being evaluated for BMP7 source. Which finding or action is most appropriate?
questions.exp: BMP7 is shown from septum transversum. (Book p982)

questions.q: In the context of Alagille syndrome, the principal ___ is:
questions.exp: Alagille is autosomal dominant with JAG1/NOTCH defect. (Book p982)

questions.q: Which option is the odd one out regarding hepatoblast?
questions.exp: Hepatoblasts form hepatocytes and cholangiocytes. (Book p982)

questions.q: Assess these statements about Kupffer cell origin: I the first statement is correct; II the second statement is incorrect.
questions.exp: The derivative table identifies Kupffer cells as resident macrophages. (Book p983)

questions.q: What is the characteristic value or relationship for portal tract?
opts: Portal vein, hepatic artery and bile duct
questions.exp: These structures comprise the portal triad. (Book p983)

questions.q: A clinical decision depends on portal venous supply. Which choice is best?
questions.exp: The diagram shows portal vein 70% and hepatic artery 30%. (Book p983)

questions.q: Which statement best describes central structure?
questions.exp: The central vein lies in the center of the classic lobule. (Book p983)

questions.q: Match the key concept in zone 1 with its correct interpretation.
questions.exp: Zone 1 is nearest the portal tract. (Book p984)

questions.q: A patient is being evaluated for zone 3 vulnerability. Which finding or action is most appropriate?
questions.exp: Zone 3 is centrilobular and least oxygenated. (Book p984)

questions.q: In the context of right superior vitelline vein, the principal ___ is:
questions.exp: The fetal venous diagram shows this derivative. (Book p984)

questions.q: Which option is the odd one out regarding Cantlie line?
opts: Gallbladder fossa to inferior vena cava
questions.exp: Cantlie line divides functional right and left liver. (Book p984)

questions.q: Assess these statements about MRP-2 gene: I the first statement is correct; II the second statement is incorrect.
questions.exp: Canalicular MRP-2 is encoded by ABCC2. (Book p985)

questions.q: What is the characteristic value or relationship for MRP-2 function?
questions.exp: MRP-2 exports conjugated bile salts into canaliculi. (Book p985)

questions.q: A clinical decision depends on stellate cell. Which choice is best?
opts: Is a bile duct epithelial cell
Stores vitamin A and becomes myofibroblast
questions.exp: Activated stellate cells release TGF-beta and promote fibrosis. (Book p985)

questions.q: Which statement best describes biliary site?
opts: Cholangiocyte disorders such as primary sclerosing cholangitis
questions.exp: Biliary disease involves cholangiocytes and bile ducts. (Book p985)
